title: docs(skills): testing.md Pattern 5 publishes `userRole` through the scope channel the renderer reads (objectui#9380)
body:
Fixes #9380

Clause-②: no — a published guide's example is corrected to the scope the renderer already publishes; no accept set or public contract surface moves

## What changed

`skills/objectui/guides/testing.md`, «Pattern 5: Component rendering with SchemaRenderer» — one fence and two prose lines above it.

- The fence handed a plain bag (`users`, `userRole`) to `SchemaRendererProvider`'s `dataSource` and gated `hidden: '${userRole !== "admin"}'` on a bare `userRole` root. Nothing publishes that root: `dataSource` carries the CRUD adapter and, since objectui#9308 landed (`852437297b`), the renderer binds no expression root from it at all. The predicate faults (`userRole is not defined`), `evaluateCondition` fails soft to `true`, the node is hidden, and `getByText('Secret')` throws for a reader who copies the example.
- The fence now publishes the same keys through `PredicateScopeProvider` — the channel `auth-permissions.md`, `schema-expressions.md`, `data-integration.md`, `page-builder.md` and `rules/protocol.md` already teach — so `${userRole !== "admin"}` is a real gate. The `hidden` expression is unchanged: a bare `userRole` is the right spelling once the host publishes it under that name.
- The admin assertion is kept as it was (`// admin should see it`). A viewer leg is added with `rerender`, so the test named "hides component when hidden expression is true" exercises its hidden branch once. Not an inversion: the admin leg still asserts the node is on screen.
- Two prose lines above the fence name the channel and the fail-soft trap and point at `guides/auth-permissions.md`.

## Measured, not inferred

Scratch vitest files under `packages/components/src/__tests__/` — root config, `dom` project (happy-dom), `@object-ui/react` aliased to `packages/react/src`, so the path exercised is the CURRENT `SchemaRenderer` evaluation memo (`configEvaluationScope`: the `usePredicateScope()` spread plus `current_user` / `record` / `page`) driving `@object-ui/core`'s `ExpressionEvaluator.evaluateCondition` from source. The real `text` renderer was registered at module scope (`import '../renderers'`), which is the reader's own setup per the guide's "Common testing mistakes" section and not this card. All three scratch files were deleted before the commit; nothing permanent was added because no existing test pins this guide's examples (`node scripts/markdown-test-inputs.mjs --list` names only tree-wide gates as readers of `testing.md`).

RED — the fence as written, `text` registered (verbatim):

```
❯ |dom| packages/components/src/__tests__/scratch-9380-registered.test.tsx (2 tests | 1 failed) 47ms
    × hides component when hidden expression is true 12ms
TestingLibraryElementError: Unable to find an element with the text: Secret.
  Reason: Failed to evaluate expression "userRole !== "admin"": userRole is not defined
```

The DOM dump under that error is an empty body holding one empty `div` — the node is hidden, not unknown. `renders component from schema` passed in the same file, so the only variable left is the root.

GREEN — the corrected fence (byte-identical to the published fence except the `describe` name and the renderer registration import; `diff` printed exactly those two hunks). Verbatim except the verbose reporter's angle-bracket separator, spelled `›` here because GitHub's body sanitizer eats tag-shaped fragments:

```
✓ |dom| packages/components/src/__tests__/scratch-9380-corrected.test.tsx › SchemaRenderer (corrected) › renders component from schema 27ms
✓ |dom| packages/components/src/__tests__/scratch-9380-corrected.test.tsx › SchemaRenderer (corrected) › hides component when hidden expression is true 8ms
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  2 passed (2)
```

Copied verbatim with only the imports the fence itself carries (no renderer registered), both tests fail on `Unknown component type: text` — the registration point the guide's own "Common testing mistakes" section already states; unchanged here.

## Line readings (published skill, net budget +6)

| reading | before | after | delta |
|---|---|---|---|
| `skills/objectui/guides/testing.md`, whole file | 364 | 369 | +5 |
| package: every `skills/**/SKILL.md` (one — `skills/objectui/SKILL.md`, 137 lines) plus the guide touched | 501 | 506 | +5 |

No re-wrap bought a line: the fence is +2 (the `it` block that gained a leg), the prose is +2, plus one blank line.

## objectui#9308 — does it change the correct spelling?

The card's «Suggested shape» offered two routes and objectui#9308 (option B, landed as `852437297b`, card state completed) removes one of them: `data: dataSource` is gone from the evaluator scope, so spelling the gate `${data.userRole}` against the injected bag would be exactly as wrong as the bare root is today — `schema-expressions.md` now warns that re-publishing `data` only restores an always-false verdict. The route that stands is publishing the name through `PredicateScopeProvider`, which is what this PR does; the bare spelling inside the expression stays because that is what a scope-published key looks like.

## Gates (run locally at `d1fda66e1a`)

- `pnpm check:skills-paths` → exit 0 — `88/89 stated path(s) resolve across 20 guide file(s); 1 baselined`
- `pnpm check:skill-eval-tokens` → exit 0 — `Every must_contain token is taught by its own skill bundle.`
- `pnpm check:control-bytes` → exit 0 — `scanned 9180 tracked text file(s)`
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations` → exit 0 — `0 new citation(s)` (re-run after the commit)
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` → exit 0 — `No source or published contract of a released package changed in this range, so no changeset is owed.` (`skills/**` sits in no package's `files[]`; no changeset and no `skip-changeset` label to write)
- `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test skills/objectui/guides/testing.md` → exit 3 — `GOVERNED — 1 of 1 path(s)` (expected: Tier H, draft only)
- the ledger's readers of `skills/objectui/**` — `check-skill-examples`, `check-skills-paths`, `check-skill-eval-tokens`, `doc-version-claims`, `layered-read-declared-path-4016`, `check-shell-escape-residue`, `check-installed-spec-pin-claims`, `dollar-dialect-alias-census`, `markdown-test-inputs`, `skill-guide-provider-envelope` → `Test Files 10 passed (10)`, `Tests 365 passed (365)`
- `pnpm check:skill-examples` → NOT MEASURED locally: exit 2 `PRECONDITION NOT MET`, no `dist/` in this worktree and the scoped build the gate names spans 30 packages (`--dry=text`), beyond the foreground budget. Declared to CI: `skill-examples.yml` runs on every PR with no path filter. This diff adds no marker and touches no marked fence, so the marked population and its floors are unchanged.
- `check:doc-snippets` / `check:doc-examples` / `check:doc-fences` — not owed: their `DOCS_ROOT` is `content/docs`, and `check-doc-snippet-types.mjs` states that `skills/objectui/**` is claimed by no gate there.

## Acceptance notes

- Renderer registration (the verbatim variant above) is the reader's setup and already documented by the guide; noted, not filed.
- The old fence passed a plain bag as `dataSource`, which objectui#7912's `DataSource` typing rejects for a reader running `tsc` (the same TS2740 shape objectui#9346 measured on the docs pages). The corrected fence passes nothing to `SchemaRendererProvider`, so that latent error leaves with it.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么** — 发布技能包 `skills/objectui/guides/testing.md` 的「Pattern 5」示例:把示例里当作表达式变量来源的 `SchemaRendererProvider` 的 `dataSource` 换成 `PredicateScopeProvider` 的 `scope`,`hidden` 表达式本身不变;补一条「非管理员看不到」的断言;围栏上方加两行说明。净增 5 行,预算 +6。

**为什么改** — 读者照抄原示例,第二个测试的断言直接抛错:`userRole` 没有被任何通道发布为表达式变量,`hidden` 表达式求值失败后按安全默认判为「隐藏」,`getByText('Secret')` 找不到节点。objectui#9308 之后所有姊妹指南都已改成本 PR 的写法,只有这一处漏了。已按当前渲染器实测:改前红、改后绿。

**风险与代价(含回滚)** — 只动一份 markdown,不改代码、不发版、不欠 changeset。风险在文字层面:示例若再次与渲染器脱节会再次误导读者,本次以实测为据。回滚 = revert 这一个 commit。
